title: 第8章 是军人不是土匪
slug: 帝少爆宠娇妻霸上瘾全本免费-帝少爆宠娇妻霸上瘾最新章节列表
content_zh:
齐原直接道：“让兽医过来！”
“你疯了！要是让少帅知道你让兽医给他治，他非宰了你不可！”
“少帅的命比我的命更重要！去！”
“呃……那个，你们别急，少帅我能治。”
云曦躲闪着那虎视眈眈的雪豹，僵着脸打断两人的争执。
冯锐齐原看了她一眼，“你？开什么玩笑！”
她是女的没错，可是她就是一未成年好吗？
染指未成年丫头，少帅醒了一样不会放过他们！
他们是军人！
不是流氓土匪！
怎么可能对一个丫头片子下手！
“我是说……我会一点医理，这个迷药你们基地只要有药我就能治，不过我有条件。”
知道他们理解歪了，云曦尴尬的红着脸，咽了咽口水解释道。
“……”俩人看了她一眼，显然是不相信她这么个丫头片子懂什么医理。
基地军医又不在，林区离市区太远，冯锐齐原没胆子让一个丫头片子给少帅治病！
要是闹出什么事儿来，司令肯定军法处置。
可若是少帅以后断了慕家香火，司令也绝对有可能让他们跟着去陪葬！
齐原斟酌再三，转头打量着这个敢跟狼群拼命的丫头。
双眸明媚澄澈不染世俗尘埃，甚至没有韩婉灵深沉的心思。
年纪小却输人不输阵，稚嫩干净的脸蛋看着像个精致的洋娃娃。

想到监控上她对付狼群的狠厉和敏捷的身手，又让他不敢小觑这么个小嫩芽儿。
“你有什么条件？”权衡到最后，齐原还是开了口。
云曦伸着被绑成木乃伊的手，比了个V的手势，笑着问：“可以提两个条件吗？”
这么小心翼翼的模样，笑起来还有两颗小虎牙，倒是让齐原觉得有些可爱，“你说。”
“天亮后送我出去，到附近的沐阳镇行吗？我要回家。”
“可以。另一个。”他们本来就是要把她送回去的。
“我一天没吃东西了，好饿……还有，把那只雪豹弄走，我怕我还没填饱肚子，就让它给填饱肚子了！”
“……”冲着这条件，齐原冯锐笑了起来。
————
云曦跟着齐原去了基地的药所翻出了几瓶西药和干净针管。
这个年代，有些西药名字和她那个年代不一样，药效还是一样的，有些甚至更强。
冯锐不放心，特地给军医打了电话。
报上了药名，确定没错后才同意云曦打针。
基地的兽医接到消息也赶了过来，有些惊讶的看着床边站着的丫头。
那拿针打针的动作和姿势标准独到，稚嫩的脸上无波无澜，沉静从容得模样既不轻佻又显得认真凝重。
若不是亲眼见了这个玲珑剔透的丫头，他还真没法把她跟那个监控视频里伤了他好几头狼的丫头联想到一起去！
云曦低垂着眸，认真的把药水推进慕非池手臂的静脉里。
一切搞定后才站起身，转头看向一旁的齐原。
“两个小时应该能醒了，回头给你们少帅喝点水，让他好好休息……啊！”
乍一看到站在兽医身边的雪豹，云曦顿时变了脸色，蹭的爬到了床上。

“你、你……不是让你把它弄出去吗？”
她一把拽着齐原挡在自己面前，一边缩着身子往床上躲。

content_en:
Qi Yuan said directly: "Let the veterinarian come over!"
"You are crazy! If the young marshal knows that you asked the veterinarian to treat him, he will kill you!"
"The young marshal's life is more important than mine! Go!"
"Uh...well, don't worry, Marshal, I can treat it."
Yun Xi dodged the eyeing snow leopard and interrupted the argument between the two with a stiff face.
Feng Rui Qiyuan glanced at her, "You? Are you kidding me!"
It's true that she is a woman, but she is just a minor, okay?
If they get their hands on underage girls, the young commander will not let them go even if he wakes up!
They are soldiers!
Not gangsters!
How could he attack a girl?
"I mean... I know a little bit about medicine. As long as your base has medicine, I can treat this drug addict, but I have conditions."
Knowing that they had misunderstood, Yun Xi blushed in embarrassment, swallowed and explained.
"..." The two of them glanced at her, obviously not believing that a girl like her knew anything about medicine.
The military doctor at the base was not here, and the forest area was too far from the city. Feng Ruiqi did not have the guts to let a girl treat the young marshal!
If anything happens, the commander will definitely handle it according to military law.
But if the young marshal ends the relationship with the Mu family in the future, the commander will definitely let them be buried with him!
Qi Yuan thought about it again and again, then turned to look at this girl who dared to fight against the wolves.
Her eyes were bright and clear, not stained by worldly dust, and did not even contain Han Wanling's deep thoughts.
Although he is young, he is good at defeating others, and his young and clean face looks like an exquisite doll.
Thinking of her fierceness and agility in dealing with wolves on the surveillance camera, he didn't dare to underestimate such a young bud.
"What conditions do you have?" After weighing the situation, Qi Yuan finally spoke.
Yun Xi stretched out her hands that were tied like mummies, made a V gesture, and asked with a smile: "Can I make two conditions?"
Such a cautious look and two small tiger teeth when smiling made Qi Yuan feel a little cute, "You tell me."
"Can you take me out after dawn to nearby Muyang Town? I want to go home."
"Okay. Another one." They were going to send her back.
"I haven't eaten for a day and I'm so hungry... Also, get that snow leopard away. I'm afraid it will fill up my stomach before I fill it up!"
"..." Qi Yuan Feng Rui laughed at this condition.
————
Yun Xi followed Qi Yuan to the pharmacy at the base and found several bottles of Western medicine and clean syringes.
In this era, the names of some Western medicines are different from those in her time, but the effects are still the same, and some are even stronger.
Feng Rui was worried and called the military doctor specifically.
After giving the name of the medicine and making sure it was correct, she agreed to Yunxi's injection.
The veterinarian at the base also rushed over after receiving the news, and looked at the girl standing by the bed with some surprise.
The movement and posture of taking the injection were unique and standard. His young face was calm and calm, making him look neither frivolous nor serious.
If he hadn't seen this exquisite girl with his own eyes, he really wouldn't be able to associate her with the girl who injured several of his wolves in the surveillance video!
Yun Xi lowered her eyes and carefully pushed the potion into the vein of Mu Feichi's arm.
After everything was done, he stood up and turned to look at Qi Yuan.
"You should wake up in two hours. Let's go back and give your young commander some water and let him have a good rest...ah!"
When she first saw the snow leopard standing next to the veterinarian, Yun Xi's expression suddenly changed and she climbed onto the bed.
"D-Didn't you...didn't I ask you to get it out?"
She dragged Qi Yuan in front of her and huddled up to hide on the bed.
